comment: Read at commit b3c1913, the only commit in the repository; its plugin.json is byte for byte the installed one, so the installed 2.0.0 is that commit. The README says 53 outputs; the module declares 52, which is also what its own list of controls adds up to, 24 knobs plus 9 faders plus 16 buttons plus 3 switches. Everything the module puts out comes from a parameter, so all 52 jacks work with no MIDI device attached at all and the controller only writes into those parameters. The screen-to-hardware direction covers lamps only: the two bank buttons and the sixteen mute and record-arm buttons are lit from here, while the knobs and faders cannot be moved from the screen because the hardware has no motors. The solo switch is deliberately not lit, which is what its tooltip, Switch 3 (no hardware LED), records. Nothing here is polyphonic. The panel prints no name on any control; the strip numbers 1 to 9 along the bottom are the only lettering.
